summary: Add guarded item price save/clear with captured AnyList protobuf operation, per-store clearing, and cache persistence.
reason: Browser capture confirms POST /data/shopping-lists/update as multipart operations with one PBListOperation using handler save-item-price and ItemPrice field 16. Price edits carry amount/store/details/date; clear carries zero amount and the current date. The CLI now previews offline, requires --apply, performs fresh live read-back verification, persists prices through a migration-safe cache column, and clears every live store-specific price when no price_store is supplied instead of silently leaving other stores behind.
validated_outcome: Focused client tests prove save-item-price, ItemPrice field 16, multipart operations, and clear representation. Store tests prove migration-safe prices persistence; CLI tests prove targeted and all-store clear planning plus read-back verification. No live writes were performed in this correction; parent disposable testing covered the exact store-specific save/clear path.
